title: Platzierungsmöglichkeiten / Größenverhältnisse / Schutzraum
slide_intent: Control spacing and scale so a familiar mark remains readable without losing layout flexibility.
strategic_value: A measurable clear space and bounded type relationship can keep DB identifiable across formats and viewing distances.
demonstration: Layout specimens precede two logo-to-headline scale examples and a half-logo-height clear-space diagram.
practical_value: Choose a flexible position while checking relative scale, edge spacing and the applicable exception process.

content_islands.name: Placement examples
content_islands.spec: Group five format examples below the statement that position can vary with the whole composition.

content_islands.name: Relative scale
content_islands.spec: Compare minimum half-cap-height and maximum double-cap-height logo relationships.

content_islands.name: Clear-space construction
content_islands.spec: Show the blue half-height perimeter around the logo beneath the exception text.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text connects clear space to protecting the mark’s effect and scale to recognition at different sizes and distances.
reference_purposes.Application: The formats and construction diagram make spacing and relative sizing inspectable.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Clear space is half a logo height; exceptions for constrained uses or composite marks are qualified and deviations require Brand Service Desk coordination.

ingredient.name: Logo scale and clear space
ingredient.role: Keep the mark visually distinct and recognizable.
ingredient.application: Use logo-to-headline relationships from half to twice the headline cap height and reserve half a logo height of clear space around the mark.
ingredient.scope: Position remains flexible; constrained wayfinding/promotional applications and composite identifiers may have exceptions. Deviations from clear space must be coordinated with Brand Service Desk.
